overall_summary: The channel shows very low overall view counts across all initial test videos (ranging from 5 to 20 views), indicating low algorithmic distribution or a brand-new channel phase. Statistical confidence is currently too low to determine definitive winning patterns, requiring broad exploration combined with structured narrative improvement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video A_eLARoegnw ('आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है,') received the highest views (20) compared to abstract hooks.
winning_patterns.action: Continue leveraging tangible, everyday objects or digital artifacts (phone contacts, chats, saved numbers) in hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing heavily on vague atmosphere like time-based prompts ('रात के दो बजे') or generic item descriptions performed slightly lower.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely abstract statements and immediately ground the hook in a specific relatable physical or digital interaction.
